postal_system.code_format: XXXXX-XXXXX full code (two-character estafeta prefix plus eight-character grid); grid-only input canonicalizes as XXX-XXXXX
postal_system.assignment_rule: The Correos Panama system launched on 7 May 2026. Its official portal returns a full two-character estafeta prefix plus eight-character grid and accepts either the full code or the eight-character grid. Only a successful release-pinned API observation can establish a time-bound full-code, postal-zone and estafeta association; syntax, a decoded coordinate, an announcement, a 2015 UPU example, an administrative code or a synthetic fixture is not a bulk assignment catalogue.
postal_system.geometry_rule: A successful official response can expose a PICO grid-cell observation and a postal-zone area value, but no reusable nationwide postal-zone polygon release with confirmed bulk redistribution terms is bundled or asserted. An area scalar is not a polygon. INEC codes and IGN 1:25,000 DPA or settlement geometry are administrative context, not Correos postal-zone or PICO geometry. Observed cells require terms, request and response digests and validity; buffers, Voronoi cells, interpolation, dissolves and model surfaces remain derived review.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, building, floor, unit, street, premises number, barrio, poblado, corregimiento, district, province or comarca, locality, estafeta, P.O. Box and geolocated code separately. The UPU February 2015 examples predate the May 2026 system; portal responses and synthetic fixtures are not production civic-address rows.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as pico_grid_cell, postal_zone, estafeta_assignment, delivery_point, locality_assignment, route, post_office, po_box, organization, point, polygon, multipolygon, unknown or derived_review_surface. A code, zone area scalar, administrative polygon, centroid, buffer or model output does not prove a reusable official postal-zone polygon.
postal_system.building_rule: The 2026 announcement describes precise home, building and point geolocation, but a returned code or PICO cell is not a stable building identifier or explicit address-to-building relation. Building-level display requires a rights-cleared stable civic-address identifier, a separately permitted building or footprint identifier and an explicit reviewed relation with source, validity, privacy, CRS and digest. Postcode, cell, zone, address string, street number, parcel, point, containment or proximity is insufficient.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Preserve province or comarca, district, corregimiento, poblado and barrio identifiers, names, source edition and validity independently from postal zone, estafeta prefix and grid. INEC administrative coding and IGN DPA geometry can validate hierarchy, while the live portal hierarchy is an observation; none may be silently substituted for the postal code or postal geometry.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Realtime official lookup or decode may validate a single observation only when request purpose, normalized query, coordinate minimisation, terms and rate policy, observed_at, response status and digest are retained; timeout, outage or empty response is unknown. Pinned observations and permitted INEC, IGN and community context may validate joins, flag drift, prioritize review and compress geometry. Every deterministic or model output records inputs, algorithm, generated_at, confidence, uncertainty and error bounds and never invents an estafeta, assignment, postal-zone boundary, address, premises number, unit, building, person or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate pinned full-code or grid observations, separately licensed administrative context, explicit civic-address or building relations and derived review surfaces to AGID cells without relabelling AGID or administrative geometry as canonical Panama postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Free public lookup is not a bulk automation, caching or redistribution licence. Correos portal observations, the Correos announcement, UPU publication, INEC resources, IGN CC BY-NC-SA layers and ODbL content retain separate terms and provenance partitions. Pin the endpoint or resource, terms snapshot, permission or licence, attribution, edition, schema, CRS and SHA-256 digest before publishing data or geometry.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The pack is ISO PA scope and stores postal, political-administrative, indigenous-comarca, statistical, cadastral, civic-address, building and AGID representations independently. It does not resolve disputed boundaries, invent island or maritime coverage, or turn administrative inclusion into postal delivery entitlement.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Coordinates, grid codes, addresses, premises numbers, units, property relations, lookup queries, recipients, organizations, owners, occupants, credentials and logs can expose household, security or commercial context. Apply purpose limitation, coordinate and log minimisation, retention, access control and publication review; exclude private and owner-linked data from public artifacts.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The UPU February 2015 sheet predates the 7 May 2026 geolocated system. Operator behavior, estafeta and zone associations, INEC codes, IGN 2025 resources updated through 2024, civic or building relations, derived surfaces and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, resource version, digest and supersession independently.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: A Hugging Face Dataset may publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet, GeoParquet or PMTiles partitions with exact attribution, release, jurisdiction, schema, CRS, digest and provenance. IGN CC BY-NC-SA data cannot be silently mixed into unrestricted commercial artifacts. Real private addresses, precise household queries, restricted property data and credentials stay private, gated or external; production AGID readers pin a Hub commit and verify shard digests.
